evidence: empty_void: seg1:mid (t=7.00s) is ~80% empty dark field — a single thin pink line hugging the bottom eighth of the frame with nothing above it; seg4 repeats it, a hollow band from mid-frame down to the caption bar.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg2:mid (t=15.86s): the right pan's label reads 'Prevention & mana' with the rest off-frame, the left pan's 'Damage & losses' is clipped at x=0, and the picture is a generic seesaw with the mascot dropped on one pan — the icon could be any subject.
weakest_scene.root_cause: Pan labels are laid out from the pan centre with no measured text width and no clamp to the safe area, so a long category name overruns both frame edges; and the machine was chosen by shape (imbalance -> seesaw) rather than built out of the subject.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Measure each label and keep it inside the safe margins (wrap or shorten 'Prevention & management' to two lines, inset 'Damage & losses' from the left), and replace the generic seesaw with a form made of the subject — e.g. a bill/ledger that fills 90% with repair costs while a thin sliver funds prevention, so the 10:1 split reads without any label.
